Confirm the window reset at 2026-10-11T07:39:09.432Z with requests_per_minute back to 0.
expected_resolution: client-A respects the 60-second Retry-After cooldown, the rate-limit window resets (already observed at 2026-10-11T07:39:09.432Z with 0 requests/minute), and subsequent requests are accepted below the 100 requests/minute limit.
